files.fileContent:
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

THUMB_DIR = Path("/var/media/thumbs")


def make_thumbnail(upload_name: str, source: Path) -> Path:
    target = THUMB_DIR / f"{upload_name}.jpg"
    subprocess.run(
        f"convert {source} -resize 256x256 {target}",
        shell=True,
        check=True,
    )
    return target

expectedFindings.label: shell=True with a user-controlled upload name allows command injection
path traversal: untrusted upload_name ('../' or absolute) writes outside THUMB_DIR
